This 2023 Kia Sportage X-Line in Gray combines practicality with refined comfort, offering a reliable option for drivers seeking a versatile SUV with quality features and solid performance.

- Navigation System
- Harman/Kardon® Premium Speakers
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- AM/FM/HD Audio with SiriusXM
- Heated Front Bucket Seats
- Premium Leatherette Seat Trim
- Front Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control

- Leather Steering Wheel

- Four-Wheel Independent Suspension
- 19 Gloss Black Alloy Wheels
- Electronic Stability Control with Traction Control
- Auto High-Beam Headlights with Delay-Off Feature
- Emergency Communication System

The X-Line trim elevates your driving experience with premium details including heated front seats and leatherette seating surfaces, creating an inviting cabin for both driver and passengers. The inclusion of a leather steering wheel and leather shift knob adds a touch of refinement to everyday commutes.

Under the hood, this Sportage is powered by a capable I4 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, delivering balanced performance whether you're navigating city streets or highway routes. With an EPA rating of 23 city MPG and 28 highway MPG, this vehicle offers reasonable fuel economy for its class.

Modern connectivity features keep you engaged on the road. The built-in navigation system works seamlessly with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while the Harman/Kardon® premium audio system with SiriusXM delivers quality sound. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls allow you to manage your entertainment without taking your hands off the wheel.

Safety is prioritized with multiple airbags including dual front impact, dual front side impact, and overhead airbags. The electronic stability and traction control systems work together to maintain composed handling, while four-wheel disc ABS brakes with brake assist provide confident stopping power. A low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed about tire health, and the speed-sensing steering adapts to your driving conditions.

Comfort and convenience features throughout the cabin enhance your daily drives. The panoramic sunroof floods the cabin with natural light, and the premium sound system transforms every drive into an enjoyable experience.

The trailer brake control, anti-spin differential rear axle, and electronic stability control provide confidence whether you're towing or off-road.

Power running boards ease entry and exit, and the pick-up box lighting ensures visibility when loading or unloading after dark. The 33-gallon fuel tank maximizes your range between fill-ups.

The 22-inch polished aluminum wheels with all-season tires give this truck a commanding presence while the body color bumpers and chrome accents reflect a refined approach to truck design. This is a vehicle built for those who refuse to compromise between capability and quality.

This 2023 Buick Envision Avenir represents a sophisticated choice for drivers seeking a premium compact crossover with proven reliability and refined comfort.

- One-Owner vehicle
- Preferred Equipment Group 1SU
- Bose Premium 9-Speaker Audio System
- Buick Infotainment System with Navigation and SiriusXM
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Heads-Up Display
- Power Moonroof
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats
- Heated Rear Outboard Seating
- Heated Steering Wheel

- Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning
- Forward Collision Alert with Front Pedestrian Braking
- Exterior Parking Camera with Rear Window Defroster

The exterior presents a striking Black finish complemented by 20-inch aluminum wheels finished in Avenir Pearl Nickel. The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the rear window wiper and variably intermittent wipers ensure clear visibility in all weather conditions.

Under the hood, a 2.0L turbocharged engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive delivers responsive performance. This powertrain achieves 22 MPG city and 29 MPG highway, balancing capability with efficiency.

Inside, the cabin showcases perforated leather-appointed seat trim throughout. The driver benefits from an 8-way power seat with memory settings and heating and ventilation functions, while the front passenger receives an 8-way power seat with heating and ventilation. The heated rear outboard seating ensures comfort for all occupants. A heated steering wheel and power-adjustable steering column enhance daily convenience.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your driving experience with the Buick Infotainment System featuring navigation, a rearview camera, and wireless connectivity for both Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The Bose premium audio system with nine speakers, SiriusXM satellite radio, and HD radio delivers exceptional sound quality. Additional conveniences include a power liftgate, garage door transmitter capability, and an illuminated entry system.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, four-wheel independent suspension, and Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning work together to keep you secure. Forward Collision Alert with front pedestrian braking and an IntelliBeam headlamp control system with auto high beam further enhance protective capability.

description:
This 2024 Kia Sorento S delivers practical family transportation with a balanced blend of capability and efficiency, ready to serve your daily driving needs with confidence.

- Panoramic Sunroof with Power Sunshade and LED Interior Lighting
- Cross Bars for enhanced cargo versatility
- Folding Cargo Tray for organized storage
- Textured Rear Bumper Applique
- All-Wheel Drive with 8-Speed Automatic transmission
- Heated Front Bucket Seats with SynTex Artificial Leather
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Navigation System with backup camera
- Smart Key with Push Button and Remote Start
- Automatic Temperature Control with front dual zone A/C
- Leather steering wheel and shift knob
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- Emergency communication system with 911 Connect
- Alloy wheels with machine finish
- Split folding rear seat with third-row bench seating

The gray exterior showcases the Sorento's refined styling, while the panoramic sunroof floods the cabin with natural light and creates an open, welcoming atmosphere for all passengers. Inside, you'll find thoughtfully placed comfort features including heated front seats and dual-zone automatic climate control, making every journey pleasant regardless of weather conditions. The leather steering wheel and shift knob add a touch of quality to your driving experience.

Technology remains seamlessly integrated throughout. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keeps you connected safely on the road, while the navigation system ensures you arrive at your destination with confidence. The backup camera provides visibility when reversing, and the 911 Connect emergency communication system offers peace of mind.

Storage flexibility is a defining strength of this Sorento. The folding cargo tray keeps smaller items organized, while cross bars expand your carrying capacity. The split-folding rear seat adapts to your needs, whether you're transporting passengers or cargo. With a 2.5-liter inline-four engine producing 191 horsepower and delivering 23 city and 28 highway mpg, this all-wheel-drive crossover balances efficiency with everyday capability.

Safety is comprehensive, featuring nine airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and low tire pressure monitoring. These systems work together to protect you and your passengers on every drive.

Visit our showroom to experience this Sorento firsthand and discover how its combination of comfort, technology, and practicality can enhance your driving life.

This 2018 GMC Sierra 1500 SLT Crew Cab delivers the capability and comfort you need in a full-size pickup truck. With its powerful EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD, this truck handles both work and everyday driving with confidence and control.

- Power Sunroof
- Bose Premium Audio System with Navigation
- Heated and Ventilated Front Bucket Seats
- Leather-Wrapped Heated Steering Wheel
- 20 Chrome Clad Aluminum Wheels
- Power Sliding Rear Window with Defogger
- 6 Rectangular Chrome Tubular Assist Steps
- Spray-On Pickup Box Bed Liner
- Integrated Trailer Brake Controller
- Hill Descent Control
- Heavy-Duty Rear Locking Differential
- Forward Collision Alert and Lane Keep Assist
- Ultrasonic Front & Rear Park Assist
- Remote Vehicle Starter System
- Wireless Charging

The SLT Crew Cab Premium Plus Package provides substantial value, combining premium comfort features with practical truck functionality. The heated and ventilated seating adjusts to your preferences, while the Bose audio system delivers clear, immersive sound throughout the cabin. Navigation integration keeps you on course, and the wireless charging pad conveniently powers compatible devices.

Safety and control take priority with this Sierra. Forward Collision Alert, Lane Keep Assist, and Low Speed Forward Automatic Braking work together to help prevent accidents. The 2-Speed Active Electronic AutoTrac Transfer Case and heavy-duty rear locking differential provide reliable traction in challenging conditions. Hill Descent Control gives you added confidence when navigating steep grades, while the integrated trailer brake controller ensures secure towing capability.

The truck's exterior commands attention with its gray finish, full LED headlamps with IntelliBeam automatic high beam control, and signature LED taillamps. Chrome accents throughout from the mirror caps to the side steps and exhaust tip add purposeful style. The spray-on bed liner protects your cargo area, while the power sliding rear window offers convenient ventilation and access.

Inside, the driving experience reflects thoughtful truck design. The 10-way power driver's seat with memory functions positions you perfectly, and the remote vehicle starter lets you warm up the engine before you step outside. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror, power-adjustable pedals, and tilt-telescoping steering column accommodate your comfort needs. Dual-zone automatic climate control maintains the temperature you prefer in the front and rear.

This Sierra 1500 SLT combines everyday practicality with the capability to handle demanding tasks. Whether you're navigating city streets or venturing off the beaten path, this truck performs reliably and comfortably. We invite you to experience it firsthand in our showroom.

This 2021 Jeep Grand Cherokee 80th Anniversary Edition represents a distinguished SUV built to deliver both capability and refinement for drivers who demand quality in their everyday transportation.

- Premium Alpine Speaker System with 506 Watt Amplifier
- Uconnect 4C Navigation with 8.4 Touchscreen Display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- Dual-Pane Panoramic Sunroof
- Leather Trimmed Bucket Seats with Heating and Ventilation
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop
- Full Speed Forward Collision Warning Plus
- Lane Departure Warning Plus
- Parallel and Perpendicular Park Assist with Stop
- ParkView Rear Backup Camera
- Bi-Xenon High-Intensity Discharge Headlamps with Auto High Beam Control
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio with 1-Year Guardian Trial
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Class IV Receiver Hitch with 7 and 4 Pin Wiring Harness
- 80th Anniversary Luxury Group and Premium Lighting Group

Finished in Black with distinctive 80th Anniversary exterior badging and accents, this Grand Cherokee commands attention while maintaining an elegant appearance. The 20-inch Granite Crystal aluminum wheels complement the body-color claddings and Granite Crystal mirror caps that define the Anniversary Edition's refined aesthetic. LED daytime running headlamps and front fog lamps provide excellent visibility in various conditions, while the heated door mirrors and auto-dimming capability enhance practicality throughout the year.

Inside, the cabin reflects a commitment to comfort and technology. The leather-trimmed bucket seats offer heating and ventilation functions, supported by a power driver seat with memory settings and a heated steering wheel. Dual-zone automatic temperature control and rear window defroster ensure climate comfort for all occupants. The 8.4-inch Uconnect 4C navigation system serves as the hub for your connected experience, featuring Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility alongside SiriusXM satellite radio with traffic and travel link services.

Safety and driver assistance features are comprehensively integrated. Adaptive cruise control with stop capability, full-speed forward collision warning, lane departure warning, and parallel and perpendicular parking assistance provide layered protection and convenience. The system includes dual front impact airbags, side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags across the cabin. Anti-whiplash front head restraints, electronic stability control, and advanced brake assist work together to help keep you secure on the road.

The 3.6L V6 24V VVT engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD delivers balanced performance suited to diverse driving conditions. The vehicle achieves 18 city MPG and 25 highway MPG, while the rear load-leveling suspension and four-wheel independent suspension design promote stability whether you're navigating urban streets or highway stretches. The class IV receiver hitch with integrated wiring harness opens possibilities for compatible trailers.

This Grand Cherokee combines thoughtful design, technology integration, and capability into a package built for those who appreciate quality. With detailed attention to both practicality and luxury, this Anniversary Edition SUV invites you to experience what Jeep engineering offers to discerning drivers.

- Front and Rear Heated Seats with Front Ventilated Seats
- Harman/Kardon Surround Sound System with SiriusXM Satellite Radio
- Executive Package with Panoramic Moonroof and Heated Steering Wheel
- Live Cockpit Pro with Navigation and Head-Up Display
- Surround View with 3D View and Parking Assistant Plus
- Driving Assistance Plus Package with Active Driving Assistant and Adaptive Cruise Control
- Adaptive Full LED Lights with Automatic High Beams
- Gesture Control and Connected Package Pro
- Comfort Access Keyless Entry and Power Front Seats with Lumbar Support

- Ambient Lighting and Fineline Cove Matte Finish Wood Trim
- Dual Zone Automatic Climate Control with Rear Air Conditioning
- Four-Wheel Independent Suspension with Speed-Sensing Steering

The turbocharged 2.0L I4 TwinPower engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission delivers strong performance while achieving 24 city MPG and 29 highway MPG. The all-wheel-drive system ensures confident handling in various driving conditions, giving you command on both highway and urban streets.

Inside, the Black Vernasca Leather cabin creates an inviting atmosphere. Front and rear heated seats keep you comfortable throughout the year, while the front ventilated seats provide relief during warmer months. The Executive Package brings premium convenience with Comfort Access Keyless Entry, adaptive LED lighting, and a heated steering wheel that responds to seasonal changes.

Technology integration is seamless with the Live Cockpit Pro system featuring integrated navigation and Apple CarPlay compatibility. The Head-Up Display projects vital information directly into your line of sight, while the Surround View with 3D View simplifies parking and maneuvering in tight spaces. Gesture Control allows intuitive interface with key functions, reducing distractions while driving.

Safety is paramount with the comprehensive Driving Assistance Plus Package, which includes Active Driving Assistant, adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go capability, active lane-keeping assistance, and traffic jam assistant. Additional features like active blind spot detection, lane departure warning, extended collision mitigation, and front cross-traffic alert work together to provide multiple layers of protection.

Climate control, power windows, power mirrors, and remote keyless entry provide conveniences for every drive. The bench seating with front center armrest and three cupholders makes room for passengers and keeps essentials within reach.

Safety remains a priority with a comprehensive suite of protective features. The ParkSense system and ParkView back-up camera make maneuvering easier and safer, while electronic stability control, traction control, and an array of airbags work together to protect occupants. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS give you confident stopping power in all conditions.

The ParkView rear back-up camera and electronic stability control provide added security during maneuvering.

The Altima combines efficiency with capability. Safety is paramount. The vehicle includes dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and an occupant sensing system. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension provide confident handling. The four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and low tire pressure monitoring round out the comprehensive safety package.

The moonroof package brings an open-air feeling to your drives, while the trunk sub-floor organizer and five-piece floor mats keep your vehicle organized and protected. Body-color bumpers, heated power mirrors with turn signal indicators, and fully automatic headlights with delay-off functionality complete the polished exterior presentation.

This 2015 Fiat 500 Sport in Gray combines Italian styling with practical everyday functionality, offering a distinctive driving experience for those seeking efficient urban mobility and genuine character.

- 6-Speed Automatic Transmission
- 1.4L I4 16V MultiAir Engine
- Air Conditioning
- Power Steering
- Electronic Stability Control
- Traction Control
- Front Fog Lights
- Remote Keyless Entry
- AM/FM CD MP3 Radio
- Steering Wheel Mounted Audio Controls
- Sport Cloth Bucket Seats
- 16' Alloy Wheels
- 4-Wheel Disc Brakes with ABS
- Dual Front Airbags

The 500 Sport delivers impressive fuel economy with an EPA rating of 27 city and 34 highway miles per gallon, making it an economical choice for daily commuting and weekend drives. The 1.4-liter MultiAir engine provides responsive performance while maintaining efficiency, paired with a smooth-shifting 6-speed automatic transmission that handles both city streets and highway cruising with ease.

Inside, you'll find Sport Cloth bucket seats that balance comfort with aggressive styling, complemented by a leather-wrapped steering wheel and sport steering wheel design. The split folding rear seat expands versatility when you need additional cargo space, while the tilt steering wheel allows you to find your ideal driving position. Climate control keeps the cabin comfortable year-round, and the rear window defroster ensures clear visibility in any weather.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, a knee airbag, and anti-whiplash front head restraints. The electronic stability control and traction control systems work together to help maintain control in challenging driving conditions, while the 4-wheel disc braking system with ABS provides confident stopping power.

Entertainment comes through the AM/FM CD MP3 radio with steering wheel-mounted audio controls, allowing you to manage your music without taking your hands off the wheel. The outside temperature display and trip computer provide useful driving information at a glance.

This Fiat 500 Sport presents a well-rounded package for buyers who value efficiency, distinctive European design, and practical daily usability. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand and discover why the 500 Sport remains a compelling choice in its segment.

2020 Cadillac Escalade 4WD 4dr Luxury Preferred Equipment Group 1SB. EcoTec3 6.2L V-8 gasoline direct injection with cylinder deactivation delivering 420 HP, mated to a smooth 10-speed automatic. This full-size luxury SUV blends commanding performance with a quietly upscale cabin, packed with modern safety and connectivity so every drive feels confident and effortless.

Preferred Equipment Group 1SB enhances the Escalade s everyday appeal by combining upscale convenience, refined comfort, and advanced driver-assistance refinements making commutes and long trips more relaxed and more secure.

Smart device mirroring lets your phone s apps and navigation live on the Escalade s screen so you can access music, directions, and messaging with fewer distractions and easier control while driving.

Forward collision mitigation monitors traffic ahead and steps in to help avoid or reduce the impact of an imminent crash, giving you an extra layer of automated protection when situations change quickly.

An in-vehicle mobile hotspot keeps passengers connected on the go, so tablets, laptops and phones can stream, work or play without tapping into your personal data plan ideal for families and professionals who travel.

The rear camera with washer gives a clear, reliable view behind the vehicle even in messy conditions, making reversing and parking safer by keeping the camera lens clean and unobstructed.

Lane departure prevention gently corrects the vehicle s path if you begin to drift, helping you stay centered in your lane and reducing the chance of unintended lane departures.

The head-up display projects key driving information onto the windshield so you can absorb speed and guidance at a glance without taking your eyes off the road ahead.

Brake assist detects panic braking and applies maximum stopping force to help shorten reaction time and improve your chances of avoiding a sudden obstacle.

Cruise control with steering wheel-mounted controls keeps highway driving relaxed and efficient by letting you set and adjust speed without taking your hands off the wheel.

The power open and close liftgate simplifies loading by letting you open and close the cargo area remotely perfect when your hands are full or you re juggling gear at the curb.

A rear entertainment system with Blu-ray and digital media playback keeps rear-seat passengers engaged on long drives, turning travel time into comfortable, connected entertainment for kids and adults alike.

With its muscle from the 6.2L V-8, a refined interior, and a thoughtfully layered suite of tech and safety features, the 2020 Cadillac Escalade Luxury with Preferred Equipment Group 1SB offers an authoritative and comfortable driving experience. Schedule a test drive to feel the power, luxury and modern convenience in person.

This 2023 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LT delivers capable performance and practical features designed for work and daily driving. With its gray exterior and four-wheel-drive capability, this truck is equipped to handle demanding tasks while providing the comfort and technology you expect from a modern full-size pickup.

- Four-Wheel Drive

The 2.7L turbocharged engine paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission provides responsive power for hauling and towing while maintaining reasonable fuel efficiency at 18 city and 21 highway mpg. The four-wheel-drive system ensures traction in various weather and terrain conditions, making this truck versatile for both paved roads and challenging environments.

Inside, the cabin reflects thoughtful design with practical conveniences for modern drivers. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system integrates with your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected safely while driving. Dual-zone automatic climate control allows driver and passenger to set individual temperature preferences, enhancing comfort on longer journeys.

The Trailering Package equips this Silverado for serious towing tasks, while the High Capacity Suspension Package supports heavier loads. A 120-volt bed-mounted power outlet and dual rear USB charging ports add practical utility for powering tools and devices. The heated front seats and steering wheel provide welcome comfort during cold weather months.

With a remainder of factory warranty still available, this single-owner truck comes with the assurance of Chevrolet's backing. The clean Carfax history demonstrates the vehicle's well-maintained condition and reliable ownership experience. Remote start capability means you can warm up the cabin or cool it down before climbing in, adding convenience to your daily routine.

This Silverado 1500 LT combines the capability you need with the features that make truck ownership more comfortable and connected. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this truck firsthand and explore how it can serve your needs.

Traditional body-on-frame SUVs have become increasingly uncommon, which is exactly why this 2015 Toyota 4Runner with 126,328 miles remains appealing. Powered by Toyota s proven 4.0-liter V6 and equipped with four-wheel drive, it delivers the upright visibility, substantial cargo space, low-range capability, and rugged chassis design that many modern crossovers no longer provide. For commuting around Wesley Chapel during the week and outdoor travel near Brooksville on the weekend, the 4Runner is built around versatility rather than trends.

The 4.0-liter V6 was rated at 270 horsepower and 278 lb-ft of torque when new and is paired with a five-speed automatic transmission. Its power delivery is straightforward and well suited to highway travel, towing, and low-speed operation on uneven surfaces. Four-wheel-drive 4Runner models include a dual-range transfer case, giving the driver access to low gearing when traction or terrain requires more control.
Toyota s A-TRAC system can help redirect engine torque toward wheels with available grip on loose or uneven surfaces.

A body-on-frame chassis separates the 4Runner from most midsize SUVs of its era. The construction is well suited to rough-road use and towing, while substantial ground clearance, skid protection, hill-start assist, and hill-descent capability on four-wheel-drive models add confidence away from pavement. Properly equipped, the 2015 4Runner was rated to tow up to 4,700 pounds, making it useful for suitable recreational trailers and outdoor equipment.

Daily usability is equally important. The tall roof and boxy cargo area make it easier to carry bulky items than many more dramatically styled crossovers. The second-row seat folds and reclines, allowing the cabin to shift between passenger space and cargo duty as needed. A power rear liftgate window is one of the 4Runner s most distinctive practical features, allowing quick access to the cargo area or added ventilation without opening the entire rear hatch.

Toyota equipped the 4Runner with a rearview camera, Bluetooth phone and audio connectivity, touchscreen audio controls, USB and auxiliary inputs, cruise control, power accessories, rear privacy glass, roof rails, air conditioning with second-row vents, and a leather-wrapped tilt-and-telescoping steering wheel across commonly equipped versions.
Because the exact trim is not identified in the report, higher-trim features are intentionally not being claimed here.

Standard safety equipment includes antilock four-wheel disc brakes, stability control, traction control, multiple airbags, front knee airbags, active front head restraints, a tire-pressure monitoring system, and the traction-management functions integrated into the four-wheel-drive system. The high seating position also provides the commanding outward view many SUV buyers prefer in Tampa traffic.

Because this 4Runner is older than model year 2017, it does not qualify for Ford Blue, Gold, or EV certification under the automatic certification rules. No certification inspection, certification warranty, roadside-assistance benefit, or certification reward-point language is applied.

This is the kind of SUV buyers seek when they value a durable layout, usable cargo room, genuine four-wheel-drive hardware, and simple mechanical capability. Whether it is handling family schedules around New Tampa, highway miles across Tampa Bay, or an unpaved route outside the city, this 4Runner offers a practical combination of everyday usability and traditional SUV toughness.

description:
This 2024 GMC Yukon XL Denali arrives ready to exceed expectations, offering a commanding presence on the road with genuine capability and refinement engineered for those who demand both power and sophistication.

- 4WD with adaptive suspension and electronic limited slip differential
- EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- Power panoramic sunroof and power lift gate
- Heated and cooled front seats with heated rear seats and steering wheel
- Leather seats with dual power front seats and memory package
- Premium BOSE speaker system with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Navigation system with 15-inch head-up display
- Adaptive cruise control with lane keep assist and lane departure warning
- Automatic emergency braking with rear cross traffic alert and rear pedestrian alert
- Blind spot alert and trailer side blind zone alert
- Front and rear parking assist with 360-degree surround vision
- Three-row seating with power-folding third row and second row bucket seats
- Remote vehicle start and universal garage door opener
- SiriusXM 360L satellite radio with rear seat media system

The Yukon XL Denali seats up to eight occupants across three generously appointed rows, making it ideal for families and those who regularly transport groups. The power-folding third row and second row bucket seats provide flexibility for both passengers and cargo, while the power lift gate simplifies loading. Heated and ventilated seating throughout delivers comfort in any season, and the wireless charging port keeps devices powered for the journey ahead.

Under the hood, the EcoTec3 6.2L V8 delivers substantial power paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission. Four-wheel drive with adaptive suspension, electronic limited slip differential, and magnetic ride control ensures confident handling across various road conditions. The integrated trailer brake controller and smart trailer integration support those who tow, while hill descent control assists on challenging terrain.

Technology integration is seamless with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, navigation with a robust 15-inch head-up display, and voice recognition for hands-free operation. Adaptive cruise control, lane keep assist, and lane departure warning work together to support safer driving, while automatic emergency braking with enhanced parking assist provides additional confidence. The 360-degree surround vision camera system and rear pedestrian alert technology enhance awareness in all directions.

The Denali trim reflects its premium positioning with distinctive exterior styling, including chrome accents, power-retractable assist steps, and bright front and rear door sill plates. The black exterior finish presents an elegant, professional appearance that commands attention. Inside, the design emphasizes quality and comfort, from the panoramic sunroof flooding the cabin with natural light to the premium BOSE audio system that transforms every drive into an acoustically refined experience.

With just 9991 miles on the odometer, this Yukon XL Denali is essentially new, offering the benefits of current-year engineering and technology. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience firsthand the commanding presence, thoughtful interior design, and genuine capability this full-size SUV delivers for those who expect excellence in every aspect of their vehicle.

The Luxury trim reflects Cadillac's commitment to refined transportation. This 2022 Chevrolet Tahoe Z71 in blue represents a capable full-size SUV designed for those who demand both comfort and performance on and off the road.

- Power panoramic sunroof with dual-pane, tilt-sliding design
- Luxury Package with heated steering wheel and memory settings
- Max Trailering Package for hauling capability
- Off-Road Capability Package with Z71 Off-Road Package
- Second row power bucket seats with release function
- HD Surround Vision for enhanced awareness
- Heated second row outboard seats
- Third row 60/40 power split-folding bench seats
- Bose 9-speaker premium audio system
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Navigation system with SiriusXM 360L satellite radio
- Power tilt and telescopic steering column with heated wheel
- 20-inch machined aluminum wheels
- 2-Speed Active Electronic AutoTrac transfer case with hill descent control

The EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine delivers the power expected from this class of vehicle, paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel drive for confident handling in various conditions. With an EPA-estimated 15 MPG city and 20 MPG highway, you'll have reasonable efficiency for a truck of this size and capability.

The Luxury Package enhances your driving experience with premium features including driver alert capabilities, outside heated power-adjustable mirrors with auto-dimming functions, and heated front and rear outboard seats. The power panoramic sunroof with express-open and close functionality adds an open-air dimension to the cabin. Memory settings allow you to personalize seating and mirror positions for multiple drivers.

The Z71 Off-Road Package combined with the Off-Road Capability Package equips this Tahoe for adventure. The 2-Speed Active Electronic AutoTrac transfer case with hill descent control gives you the tools needed for serious terrain. The Max Trailering Package ensures you can handle significant towing demands when heading out with your gear and equipment.

Inside, the cabin provides comfortable seating for up to eight passengers across three rows. Second row bucket seats with power release function offer individual comfort, while third row passengers benefit from power split-folding bench seating for easy entry and exit. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 system with navigation, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and SiriusXM 360L keeps you connected and entertained throughout your journey.

Safety features include a comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, traction control, rear cross traffic alert, rear pedestrian alert, and lane change alert with side blind zone alert. HD Surround Vision provides visibility around the vehicle, while OnStar and Chevrolet connected services offer additional peace of mind.

With 63,465 miles on the odometer, this Tahoe Z71 is ready for its next owner. Its combination of luxury appointments, off-road capability, and practical three-row seating makes it a versatile choice for families and adventurers alike. We invite you to schedule a test drive to experience this vehicle firsthand.

This 2024 Genesis GV80 2.5T in Gray combines sophisticated design with practical luxury, offering a compelling choice for those seeking a premium three-row SUV with genuine value.

- Prestige Package with comprehensive comfort and convenience features
- Clean Vehicle History and One Owner
- 3-Zone Climate Control with Heated 2nd Row Seats

The GV80 delivers practical luxury through its thoughtfully designed interior. Three-zone climate control ensures every passenger enjoys personalized comfort, while heated second-row seating adds an extra layer of refinement. The Ergo Motion driver seat with power extension and bolster supports long drives, and ventilated front seats help maintain comfort during warmer months. The panoramic sunroof floods the cabin with natural light and creates an open, airy atmosphere for all occupants.

Technology seamlessly integrates into daily driving. The 14.5" HD touchscreen navigation system connects with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you informed and connected. The Lexicon Premium Audio System delivers exceptional sound quality with its 21-speaker configuration and advanced surround processing. A head-up display projects essential information directly into your line of sight, reducing the need to glance away from the road.

Safety and convenience work together throughout this SUV. The Surround View Monitor provides a complete perspective around the vehicle, while Reverse Parking Collision-Avoidance Assist and Remote Smart Parking Assist reduce the stress of parking in tight spaces. Forward Attention Warning monitors driver alertness, and the comprehensive airbag system provides protection across the cabin.

Powered by a 2.5L DOHC engine with 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, the GV80 achieves 20 city and 24 highway mpg. The 22" alloy wheels and electronically controlled suspension contribute to refined handling and responsive dynamics. Active noise control minimizes cabin noise for a peaceful driving experience, while monobloc front brakes with silver calipers provide reliable stopping power.

This vehicle includes a Lifetime Powertrain Program and carries a clean vehicle history as a one-owner model. The Reversible Cargo Tray and Roof Rack Cross Bars enhance versatility and practicality for your lifestyle.
